Protests Erupt Over Alleged Voter Roll Tampering Ahead of 2027 Polls

Protests have emerged across India concerning alleged tampering and freezing of electoral rolls, with concerns raised that these actions could disenfranchise young voters, particularly Gen Z, ahead of the 2027 general elections. Several individuals were detained by police during protests, including those described as Gen Z-led demonstrations. Congress leader Jairam Ramesh has specifically alleged that a freeze on electoral rolls could prevent Gen Z voters from participating in the 2027 polls. Actor Shabana Azmi and filmmaker Vishal Bhardwaj have joined protests organized by the Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP) against alleged electoral roll tampering.
